QuestInfo.name: Flickering Aran Memories
QuestInfo.0: Of the 12 Aran Memory Fragments that Cassandra mentioned, you just need one more! And as you may have guessed, you must go see Cassandra to find the last memory.
QuestInfo.2: Finally! You've finished collecting all 12 Aran Memory Fragments. But what are all these memories anyway?
